builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Vayne: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (7,542 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55.1% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A mobile single-target marksman who repeatedly attacks one target for Silver Bolts, using tumble and terrain knockback to preserve contact. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Blade of The Ruined King → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Berserker's Greaves, Guardian Angel, Wit's End.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: Blade of The Ruined King → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Blade of The Ruined King → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55.1% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Blade of The Ruined King → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

builds.name: AP tumble packet
builds.summary: Investigate Q AP damage in an actual Spellblade attack while preserving Silver Bolts cadence.
builds.goal: Investigate Q AP damage in an actual Spellblade attack while preserving Silver Bolts cadence.
builds.hypothesis: Q next attack adds 0.5 AP but deals physical damage; Lich Bane and Nashor add separate magic attack packets. R reduces Tumble cooldown and grants one second invisibility on Q, buying a spacing window. Rageblade can be tested for Silver Bolts delivery rather than presumed to copy the third-hit counter.
testPlan: Required state: Same target for consecutive W actions; finite Rageblade ramp and R active.
Separate physical Q, magic item packets and true W at matched consecutive attacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD and attack commitment can lose damage before the next Silver Bolts trigger.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic penetration does not improve Q physical damage or W true damage.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Vayne: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A mobile single-target marksman who repeatedly attacks one target for Silver Bolts, using tumble and terrain knockback to preserve contact. Keep Silver Bolts on one target and record real Tumble/Condemn spacing. Extra bolts/phantom effects must be verified; true damage is not multiplied by armor penetration. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Vayne: Keep Silver Bolts on one target and record real Tumble/Condemn spacing. Extra bolts/phantom effects must be verified; true damage is not multiplied by armor penetration.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.

builds.name: Condemn frost pocket
builds.summary: Use Q Spellblade slowing to hold a wall angle for Condemn and three real hits.
builds.goal: Use Q Spellblade slowing to hold a wall angle for Condemn and three real hits.
builds.hypothesis: Iceborn rewards the actual post-Tumble attack with a frost field; E only gains its extra damage and stun when the target hits terrain. BotRK adds a current-health physical on-hit and three-attack slow, while Terminus supplies finite mixed penetration/resistance stacks. R/Night Hunter improve pursuit after the controlled pocket.
testPlan: Required state: A real wall behind the target and same-target attack access; item stacks start recorded.
Record E wall success and time to three same-target attacks versus a moving opponent.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The frost field cannot create terrain or rescue a failed E angle; armor spending lowers carry output.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Iceborn slows do not make every Condemn a wall stun.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
